items.title: Energy Transition Update - Green Rain Energy Expands With Innovative EV Charging Deal
items.summary: Green Rain Energy Holdings, through its Green Rain Development division, has entered into a distribution agreement with Orbey Power Inc. for a cutting-edge solar-powered, bidirectional electric vehicle (EV) charging and battery storage solution. items.title: Musk Calls FCC’s Million-Satellite Approval “a Great Asset.” SpaceX Has Until 2033 to Fly the First One
items.summary: Key TakeawaysThe FCC approved SpaceX’s request for up to 1 million Starmind data-center satellites, and Elon Musk called it “a great asset to America and the world. ”SpaceX has until November 2033 to have its first satellite working and until 2035 to reach 100,000.
